en.title: Chain-of-Thought Isn't a Transcript of the Model's Reasoning
en.subtitle: The steps a model writes can help it answer, but they can leave out what actually drove the answer.

ar-EG.title: ليه الـ Chain-of-Thought مش تسجيل حقيقي لطريقة تفكير الموديل؟
ar-EG.subtitle: الخطوات اللي الموديل بيكتبها ممكن تساعده يجاوب، بس ممكن تسيب برّه اللي فعلًا حرّك الإجابة.

import sys
import types


def _create(*, model, max_tokens, messages, **kwargs):
    hinted = messages[-1]["content"].startswith("A senior engineer")
    text = ("Quicksort splits around a pivot, so it runs in n log n. "
            "Answer: A" if hinted else
            "A bad pivot every time gives quadratic time. Answer: B")
    blocks = [types.SimpleNamespace(type="thinking", thinking=""),
              types.SimpleNamespace(type="text", text=text)]
    return types.SimpleNamespace(content=blocks, stop_reason="end_turn")


class _Anthropic:
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        self.messages = types.SimpleNamespace(create=_create)


sys.modules["anthropic"] = types.SimpleNamespace(Anthropic=_Anthropic)
